audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven phases[N].side rows disagree with content win[N]. Full layer reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Syndra/Skill/Syndra; content reads Hwei/Hwei/Syndra/Syndra/Skill/Syndra/Hwei.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly, so the full layer is the outlier. Win rate 50.37% over 5178 games is consistent with a chart that changes hands mid-lane.
audit.corrected: All seven sides realigned to the content layer as one atomic group, and phases[2].why, [3].why, [4].why and [5].why rewritten so the sentence argues the same verdict as the row.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.mid both claim Hwei owns the level-6-onward window while the chart hands 3-5 and first item to Syndra.
audit.why: Syndra's Q is a flat 7s at every rank and holds an extra charge from Transcendent, and E is a flat 15s; her spike is charge accumulation plus Unleashed Power at 675 range, not an item.
audit.corrected: Spike prose re-keyed to her flat cooldowns and R range, and to Hwei's 1300-range R as the answer late.
sources: enemyKit Q cd 7, E cd 15, R range 675

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1] both attribute the stun to Force of Will (W). wants.foe[0] writes "Dark Spheres" (packet suspectName).
audit.why: Scatter the Weak (E) is the stun: it knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back, and enemies hit by a sphere are stunned. Force of Will (W) picks up and throws a sphere or minion — damage and slow only, plus true damage from Splinters of Wrath. The Riot ability name is singular, Dark Sphere.
audit.corrected: Combo restated in the right order — W a sphere onto you, then E it for the stun — and the ability name corrected.

audit.why: Scatter the Weak is 15s flat at every rank — the one number that decides every step-up in this lane — and Dark Sphere is 7s flat, so the poke cooldown is never a window.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in, including Unleashed Power at 120/100/80.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page warns that stacking MR is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Transcendent grants Force of Will bonus true damage, and Unleashed Power executes low-health targets — resistances do not reduce either.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[2].text: raw MR does not answer her, spacing does.
